text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Espoir 
City, she mentioned wanting to stop by an 
accessory shop, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Still, though, direction-wise, this way 
definitely feels a bit...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Gah!? H-Haaah?! Of course I'm going, you 
punk!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell I'm gonna be spooked by some 
feng shui crap!!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Today, you must avoid anything 'pitch 
black' and steer clear of the unlucky 
'northeast' direction! And above all, an 
'aquarium' is an ABSOLUTE no-go!!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san... You should probably save the 
shopping for next time. Your fortune is in 
a slump right now...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: That's what Ricky told me, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Lookin' at it the other way, all I gotta 
look out for are "pitch-black things," 
"northeast," and "fish tanks"!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Think of it that way and it's a piece of 
cake! Come on, let's get a move on 
already, hey!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"A wrapped train car!? Isn't it pitch 
black!?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn it! Fine, I ain't taking no train!! 
I'm runnin' all the way to the next 
station, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant* *pant*... How d'ya like 
that! Don't you dare underestimate an 
Umamusume's legs...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Now, if we just go straight down this 
road—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...Whoa!? Isn't that northeast!?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Then... we're not taking this path! We're 
taking a boat straight across the pond!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: It's that swan boat! You row too!

Afterward, taking a detour, we finally 
made it near our target store! However—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... You've gotta be kidding me... 
Even inside this arcade...
choice_data_list:
There's a huge aquarium in front of the 
fish market...!

text_block_list.text: You can't do that, Espo-san.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely not letting you past here.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop having this terrible feeling 
of misfortune. As your friend... I can't 
just ignore it!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...That look on your face. Saying you 
won't let me through no matter what, huh."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving up that accessory for 
anything—!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Aah... wait for me--!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Haha. —Hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ALRIGHTTTTT!! I finally got it!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Limited quantity! Silver Chain 
Braceleeeet!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
No regrets now! Bring on whatever bad luck 
you've got!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...? Huh? Nothing's happening?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, of course! That's an option!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! In feng shui, silver accessories 
have an amazing meaning! Intuition, gentle 
protection... boldness and peace of mind!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san! With good-luck charms and sheer 
willpower, I've carved out my own good 
fortune☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Nah, not really. It wasn't like I 
did it for feng shui or anything...
choice_data_list: In short, your guts won it for you!

In short, it was your determination that 
won out!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Nah, not really. It wasn't like I 
did it for feng shui or anything...
choice_data_list: In short, your guts won it for you!

In short, it was your determination that 
won out!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah, don't underestimate me! Even bad luck 
won't stop me from soaring!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Espo-san's grit and her respect 
for feng shui... ...even I was deeply 
moved~☆

Having overcome her bad luck and gotten 
her hands on the bracelet she was after, 
Espoir City wore a triumphant grin.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's this?! So you've actually got 
some taste after all. Hey!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
By the way, if you polish that bracelet 
nicely and place it facing west—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? Alright, gotta clear off a 
shelf when I get back!
